notes.title: New graphics!
notes.content:
Here we go! We finally have new graphics for the game and are ready to go! 

Hope you have fun with this frustrating game where everything explodes if you make mistakes :)

notes.title: Wild shapes
notes.content:
Here we have a special component that allows very interesting combinations on how to manage heat - it almost like teleports heat to another location.

Who are familiar with Reactor idle game, there we had teleport component that distributed heat to all other outputs. This one here is a simplified version of it.
